title: Atlassian pre-placement talk
content: Atlassian will host a pre-placement talk in the main auditorium. Engineering leads will cover the interview process and the teams that are hiring. Attendance is mandatory for registered candidates.

title: Deutsche Bank shortlist published
content: The shortlist for the Technology Analyst internship has been published. Shortlisted candidates should check their application status and confirm their interview slot within 48 hours.

title: Resume verification closes this Friday
content: All final-year students must upload a verified resume before Friday. Applications submitted without a verified resume will not be forwarded to recruiters.

title: Updated placement policy for the current cycle
content: The one-offer policy now applies once a student accepts a full-time role above 15 LPA. Internship conversions are counted separately. The full policy document is available with the placement office.

title: Zoho campus drive scheduled for next week
content: The Zoho drive will run over two days. Day one is the online programming round in the computer centre; day two covers the design discussion and the final technical interview. Bring your institute ID card.

title: Texas Instruments technical session on digital design
content: A technical session covering RTL design, verification workflows, and the day-to-day work of the embedded processing group. Recommended for anyone considering the hardware track.

title: Mock interview drive open for registration
content: Alumni volunteers will conduct mock technical and HR interviews over the coming fortnight. Slots are limited and allocated first come, first served. Register through the placement coordinators.

title: Sprinklr internship applications now open
content: The Sprinklr product engineering internship is open to the pre-final year. Strong performers convert to a full-time offer. Applications close along with the registration deadline listed on the job profile.

title: How to raise an NOC request
content: Students holding an off-campus offer must raise an NOC request through the portal before accepting it. Include the offer letter and the exact engagement dates. Requests are processed within three working days.
